name: IndiGo
narrative: Management delivered on Q2 FY27 passenger unit revenue growth guidance of over 25%, achieving 31% growth. However, performance diverged in Q3 FY26 when passenger unit revenue fell 4.5% against guidance of flattish growth, and capacity grew 11% versus high teens guidance.

promises.statement: IndiGo expects high teens capacity growth for Q3 and Q4 FY26 compared to last year.

said.quote: As we move to the seasonally strong second half of the financial year, based on the market opportunity and addition of long-haul, we are pleased to announce that will be able to grow by high teens for both the third and fourth quarter of the current financial year as compared to the same period last year

actual_source.quote: capacity in terms of ASKs grew by around 11% for the quarter, at the upper end of the guided range

promises.note: Q3 FY26 capacity grew only 11% YoY and Q4 FY26 guidance was cut to around 10%.

promises.statement: IndiGo estimates flattish to slight growth in passenger unit revenues for Q3 FY26.

said.quote: On the revenue side, basis the trends of October, we are estimating a flattish to slight growth in passenger unit revenues (PRASK) for the third quarter as compared to a high base during the same period last year

actual_source.quote: The passenger unit revenue came in at 4.51 rupees, which is 4.5 percent lower on a year-over-year basis, in line with our revised guidance

promises.note: Q3 FY26 passenger unit revenue fell 4.5% YoY compared to guided flattish to slight growth.

promises.statement: IndiGo expects capacity growth in high teens for Q4 FY26 compared to last year.

said.quote: As we move to the seasonally strong second half of the financial year, based on the market opportunity and addition of long-haul, we are pleased to announce that will be able to grow by high teens for both the third and fourth quarter of the current financial year as compared to the same period last year

actual_source.quote: Moving on to the forecast for the fourth quarter of this financial year, we are expecting to add capacity of around 10 percent as compared to the same period last year

promises.note: Q4 FY26 capacity guidance was reduced from high teens to around 10% YoY in Q3.

promises.statement: PRASK growth is expected to be more than 25% year-on-year in Q2 FY27.

said.quote: In terms of unit passenger revenue or PRASK for Q2FY27, with the current balanced demand￾supply equation and the higher fares holding up, we are expecting growth of more than 25% compared to the same period last year

actual_source.quote: Passenger unit revenue (PRASK) growth, Q2 FY27: 25.9%

signals.quote: Over FY22–FY26, operating cash flow of ₹83,658 crore covered all of reported profit, ₹6,568 crore.
signals.source: Computed from screener.in's cash-flow statement and ratios

cash.read: Profits convert strongly into cash, with operating cash flow of ₹83,658 crore far exceeding total reported net profit of ₹6,568 crore over FY22–FY26.

bull.point: Free cash balance reached ₹39,900 crore at the end of Q2 FY27, maintaining strong liquidity.

evidence.quote: Our liquidity remains strong, with free cash of around 399 billion rupees

bull.point: Passenger unit revenue surged 31% YoY in Q2 FY27, driving total income up 24% YoY to ₹24,300 crore.

evidence.quote: Third, in this environment, we delivered a 31 percent increase in PRASK, which exceeded our guidance of more than 25 percent growth
Moving on to the headline numbers, we reported a total income of 243 billion rupees, representing a growth of 24 percent year over year

bull.point: Cargo business delivered strong expansion with revenue growing 37% year-on-year in Q2 FY27.

evidence.quote: Our cargo business is also performing well, delivering strong revenue growth of 37 percent year-on-year during the quarter

bear.point: Net loss of ₹1,900 crore was recorded in Q2 FY27 due to an elevated cost environment despite 24% total income growth.

evidence.quote: However, due to the elevated cost environment, we reported a net loss of 19 billion rupees
Moving on to the headline numbers, we reported a total income of 243 billion rupees, representing a growth of 24 percent year over year

bear.point: Tax disputes not acknowledged as debt totaled ₹24,185 million through AY 2022-23, with tax authority appeals pending before the High Court.

evidence.quote: The tax exposure (excluding interest and penalty) for matters disallowed by income tax authorities up to AY 2022-23 i.e. the last year assessed, amounts to Rs. 24,185
